_readme: Copy this file, delete the fields starting with underscore, and fill in one object per non-human identity under 'identities'. Only 'id' and 'name' are required; every other field has a safe default, so a partial inventory still assesses. The more you fill in, the sharper the risk tiering. Run with:  nhi-scan scan your-inventory.json

_allowed_values.owner: email/team string, or null if orphaned (null is flagged)
_allowed_values.last_rotated_days: integer days since the credential was rotated, or null if never/unknown
_allowed_values.last_used_days: integer days since last activity, or null if unknown
_allowed_values.scopes: list of permission strings; '*' or trailing ':*' is treated as a wildcard
_allowed_values.autonomous: true for an AI agent that acts without per-action human approval
_allowed_values.third_party: true if issued to / operated by an outside vendor
_allowed_values.human_used: true if a human logs in interactively with this identity
_allowed_values.shared_across_env: true if the same identity/credential is used in both prod and non-prod
_allowed_values.used_by: list of workloads sharing this identity; more than one is flagged as reuse
_allowed_values.tools: for AI agents: list of tools/connectors/MCP servers the agent can invoke (its reach); tracked by `nhi-scan diff`

identities._note: MINIMAL record — only id and name are required. Everything else falls back to a conservative default.
identities.name: human-readable-name

identities._note: FULL record — every field populated. Use this as your copy-and-edit template.
identities.name: payments-batch-runner
